name: Event-Day 0DTE Long Straddle / Strangle
summary: Buying a same-day straddle or strangle immediately before a scheduled macro release to own gamma through the print - the long-vol mirror of every other 0DTE structure in the bank.

legs.strike_rule: the strike nearest spot at 5 minutes before the release (straddle), or delta 0.25-0.35 for the cheaper strangle version
the same strike as the call (straddle) or |delta| 0.25-0.35 (strangle)

max_profit: UNLIMITED in principle - $100 per point beyond the breakevens on whichever side moves
max_loss: the full debit paid, and at 0DTE that is the likely outcome if the release is a non-event
breakevens: strike +/- total debit per share (straddle); call strike + debit and put strike - debit (strangle)

greeks.gamma: the largest positive gamma available anywhere - this is what is being bought
greeks.theta: very large and negative; the position bleeds by the minute
greeks.vega: positive, but 0DTE vega is small - the payoff comes from realized movement, not from IV

typical_dte: 0 DTE only, held for minutes to a few hours
when_to_use: Scheduled, binary-ish macro releases with a history of large same-day index moves: FOMC statement (14:00 ET) and press conference (14:30 ET), CPI (08:30 ET), NFP (08:30 ET). The edge, when it exists, is that 0DTE implied moves sometimes underprice event days - it must be measured, not assumed.
entry_rules: SPY or QQQ only. Locally computed greeks and implied move required (Alpaca supplies neither at 0DTE).
Enter no earlier than 10 minutes and no later than 2 minutes before the scheduled release. Never enter after the print - the vol is already paid for by then.

PRICING GATE: the 0DTE straddle's implied move (total debit / spot) must be BELOW the median absolute same-day move for that release type over the last 12 occurrences. If it is at or above, skip the day. This is the only rule that separates the trade from a coin flip with negative carry.
Total debit per unit <= 0.5% of equity ($250 on $50k); at most 1 event trade per day; counts against the 3%-per-day 0DTE budget.
Prefer the strangle over the straddle when the straddle's debit fails the pricing gate but the 0.30-delta strangle passes.
Both legs OI >= 1000, one MLeg order, no chasing beyond $0.03.
No other 0DTE short-premium position may be open in the same underlying at the moment of the release.
management_rules: Take profit at 50-75% gain on the package, or close the profitable leg and let the loser run only if the remaining leg's value is under 10% of the original debit.
Hard time stop: if the position is not profitable 20 minutes after the release, close it. The event has happened; from here it is pure theta.
Never add to a losing event straddle.
Do not convert it into a short position by selling a further strike after the print - that creates a naked leg intraday.
exit_rules: Flatten by 15:30 ET without exception, and in practice within an hour of the release.
Never allow an ITM long leg to reach expiry: auto-exercise buys or sells 100 shares of SPY (about $60k) overnight. Close any long leg whose delta exceeds 0.90 immediately.
If the release is cancelled, delayed or leaked early, close at once - the pricing gate no longer applies.
Log the realized move versus the implied move for every occurrence; the pricing gate's 12-observation window depends on it.
assignment_risk: No short legs, so no assignment risk. The only stock-delivery path is auto-exercise of an ITM long leg at expiry, eliminated by the delta-0.90 close rule and the 15:30 flatten.
liquidity_needs: SPY/QQQ 0DTE around a release are liquid but the spread widens materially in the 60 seconds either side of the print - fill before the release, not during it.
common_mistakes: Buying the straddle after the number is out; ignoring the pricing gate and paying an implied move larger than anything the release has ever delivered; holding for hours hoping the trend continues while theta takes the whole debit.
zero_dte_notes: 0DTE is the entire point - the same trade at 7 DTE is a vega trade, not a gamma trade, and has completely different rules.
family: Completeness gap-fill (cross-family): ratio/naked-financed put and call structures, quantity-unbalanced condors and strangles, stock+option overlays and monetizations, capital-protection and hybrid builds, 0DTE four-leg income, volatility-surface and relative-value trades, event-driven overlays, and roll/adjustment structures
